dct_description_sm:
Household food insecurity is a serious public health issue that can negatively affect the health of individuals, families, and our communities. For this reason, the City of Kingston is providing a list of local food resources as part of the Community Development and Well-being team. This dataset includes resources for low to no cost food resources, including but not limited to Community Food Programs, location of Community Gardens, Cultural Food Stores, Farm stands and low cost grocery stores.
